description: This map displays a false-colour infrared (likely Near-Infrared) satellite or aerial image of a landscape, characteristic of agro-forestry systems such as Dehesa regions. The imagery predominantly shows vegetation in bright pink-red, appearing as a speckled texture across large areas, which indicates scattered trees or scrub. Sparser vegetation or bare ground is rendered in lighter grey or white. The landscape is traversed by numerous thin white linear features, likely unpaved tracks or natural drainage patterns. A prominent dark grey linear feature, resembling a road or a major track, with parallel light blue borders, runs across the lower portion of the image. Small, light blue circular features, possibly artificial ponds or small water bodies, are visible in the upper-middle left and lower-middle right areas. Overlaid on this imagery are black polygonal boundaries with white outlines, which delineate distinct land cover units. These polygons are labelled with numeric classification codes: "2340" appears in the upper right and lower left within areas dominated by speckled pink-red vegetation, while "1210" is located in the lower central part, adjacent to the prominent dark linear feature. No scale bar, compass, or specific date is visible.
